findings.detail: `plan-contract.json#/implementation_sequence` is valid as a phase narrative, but if copied directly into tasks it will collide on shared write sets: wave 2 collapses ten isolated sample trees plus catalog coupling, and wave 3 collapses router, output, error, selector, and copy-state changes that must join on shared surfaces. The task graph must refine these waves into isolated lanes plus explicit join points before any `[P]` marking is safe.
findings.title: The current implementation waves are too coarse to use as executable task batches

findings.detail: The accepted plan and handoffs define `AC-001`..`AC-012`, `CA-001`..`CA-004`, `MP-001`..`MP-010`, and OCD stop/reopen rules, but there is no existing task-layer guarantee yet that each acceptance ref will receive one dedicated system-review witness and a non-empty Human Acceptance Universe. This is a task-generation gap, not a scope defect, and must be resolved before task finalization.
findings.title: Coverage obligations are defined upstream but not yet materialized into task-layer witnesses

findings.detail: `GAP-002` means `docker-compose-helpdesk` cannot be silently passed. The final task graph needs an explicit prerequisite or fail-closed CI gate for Docker-backed lifecycle evidence; otherwise the Windows/Linux denominator can be undercounted while appearing green.
findings.title: Docker runner capability remains a release-critical prerequisite gap

findings.detail: `GAP-003` and the accepted `validation-scenarios` handoff show the clean worktree does not currently have the installed dependencies needed for CLI-spawn tests. Task validation should schedule `npm ci` before install-dependent checks and reopen design only if the targeted contracts still fail after dependency materialization.
findings.title: Fresh CLI-spawn verification is environment-blocked until dependencies are materialized

observations.detail: Do not mark tasks touching `src/cli.js`, `src/output.js`, `src/errors.js`, `examples/sample-projects/catalog.json`, `package.json`, `README.md`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, or shared test contract files as `[P]`. These surfaces are shared coordination points for IF-001, IF-002, IF-003, IF-004, IF-005, and IF-006 and must be stabilized sequentially before downstream lanes consume them.
observations.pass_condition: Catalog schema, CLI grammar, output-envelope, and public error-code contracts are stable enough that downstream sample, copy, and package lanes no longer need to edit shared router/output/error surfaces in parallel.
observations.recovery: If JP-01 fails, keep all sample, package, and lifecycle work blocked; repair the shared contract surfaces first and rerun the same targeted contract tests.
observations.title: Serialize shared write sets before any parallel fan-out

observations.detail: After ARCH-007 exact inventory is frozen, parallelism is safe only at the per-sample directory boundary: each lane writes one `examples/sample-projects/<id>` tree plus its sample-local tests/assets and does not touch `catalog.json`, package files, shared docs, or shared CI. A single join task must then update `examples/sample-projects/catalog.json` and reconcile repository contract expectations against the authored trees.
observations.pass_condition: Exactly ten approved IDs exist, every source directory is present exactly once, catalog fields are allowlisted, ports are unique, and forbidden Launchdeck/evaluation/runtime artifacts are absent from all sample roots.
observations.recovery: Repair any sample-local drift in the affected sample lane; if IDs, stacks, or themes need to change, stop and reopen per OBS-010 and ARCH-007 instead of mutating scope inside tasks.
observations.title: Safe parallel batch: ten standalone sample directories only after ID freeze

observations.detail: `src/examples/catalog.js`, `src/examples/list.js`, and `src/examples/copy.js` can be separate implementation lanes only if the router/output/error contract from JP-01 is already frozen and each lane stays out of `src/cli.js`, `src/output.js`, and `src/errors.js`. The join task owns `src/examples/index.js`, final router wiring, stable error-code exposure, and any output-envelope adaptations required by OUT-EX-LIST-OK through OUT-EX-RENAME-FAIL.
observations.pass_condition: The real entrypoints `launchdeck example list [--json] [--compact] [--no-color]` and `launchdeck example copy [<id>] [<destination>]` emit stable schemaVersion 1 envelopes, typed recoverable outcomes, and no prompt or mutation outside the allowed TTY omitted-ID path.
observations.recovery: If any outcome is unstable or normalizes to `internal_error`, keep packaging and lifecycle tasks blocked, repair router/error/output ownership, and rerun the targeted CLI contract suite before resuming.
observations.title: Safe parallel batch: internal example modules, then one router/output join

observations.detail: Do not jump directly from authored samples to the full Windows/Linux native and Launchdeck matrix. First stabilize one representative end-to-end path using `fastapi-inventory` exactly as `quickstart.md` defines, including native install/test/start/health/stop and external `.launchdeck.yml` lifecycle proof in an isolated copy. Only after that gate passes should tasks fan out to the ten-sample-by-two-OS native and Launchdeck matrices.
observations.pass_condition: The copied tree matches packaged source, native health succeeds, Launchdeck owns and cleans its process, the source sample stays Launchdeck-neutral, and evidence is sufficient to template the remaining matrix without changing product behavior.
observations.recovery: If representative lifecycle proof fails, reopen the lifecycle harness or sample-specific task before scheduling the full matrix; do not debug forty matrix cells concurrently.
observations.title: Insert a representative lifecycle gate before full matrix fan-out
observations.validation_command: Use the `quickstart.md` scenario exactly, then run the first isolated native plus Launchdeck fixture validation for `fastapi-inventory` on one supported OS.

observations.detail: The task graph should create one dedicated required system-review scenario for each `spec-contract.json#/acceptance_criteria/0..11`, plus a separate Human Acceptance Universe limited to human-exercisable journeys. Minimum human-required journeys are: list human view success, explicit copy success, TTY omitted-ID search-select success, TTY no-match/edit path, TTY cancel, destination-conflict refusal, and the representative quickstart user path. Package size gates, digest parity, and full Windows/Linux matrices are required system-review evidence, not human-acceptance substitutes.
observations.pass_condition: Zero uncovered `acceptance_refs`, zero uncovered required human obligations, and no scenario relies on broad regression coverage as the sole witness for an acceptance ref.
observations.recovery: If any acceptance ref or human journey is uncovered, add or split review tasks before finalizing the task graph; do not defer coverage repair to implementation or review.
observations.title: Tasks must materialize dedicated system-review and human-acceptance coverage
observations.validation_command: Task synthesis review: prove every acceptance ref has a dedicated required system-review witness and every human-required journey maps to at least one linked review scenario with an official entrypoint.

observations.detail: High-risk joins must inherit the explicit stop/reopen conditions already defined in OCD-001..OCD-012 and OBS-010. In practice that means tasks must fail closed on non-atomic publish, overwrite/merge behavior, unstable error codes, catalog drift, generated Launchdeck artifacts entering sources, package size overrun, silent CI skip, and unrepaired Windows/Linux lifecycle failures. GAP-002, GAP-003, and GAP-004 are advisory constraints that must remain visible in validation and reopen logic.
observations.pass_condition: All acceptance, MP, CA, package, and lifecycle obligations are evidenced with no silent skip, no residue after failure/cancel, and no source/copy/tarball mismatch.
observations.recovery: Reopen the exact failing task or prerequisite gate; do not shrink the ten-project denominator, relax Windows/Linux requirements, or reinterpret failure as deferred scope.
observations.title: Carry stop/reopen and recovery rules into every high-risk join
observations.validation_command: npm run check && npm test && npm audit && the explicit package/native/Launchdeck matrix commands defined by the final task graph

critical_notes: No product source, tests, package files, README, CI, or canonical artifacts were edited directly by this lane.
Canonical plan inputs were read through .\.specify\bin\specify-runtime.exe artifact show.
Accepted planning handoffs were read through the runtime-owned artifact paths exposed by planning/lane-manifest.json.

summary: Dependency-safety lane recommends serializing shared CLI/catalog/package surfaces, parallelizing only isolated sample and post-foundation validation lanes, and carrying explicit join-point recovery plus dedicated acceptance/system-review/human-acceptance coverage into the canonical task graph.
